newsitem.title: USA: Boyd to sell stake in Louisiana casino.
newsitem.headline: Boyd to sell stake in Louisiana casino.

text.p: Boyd Gaming Corp said Monday it had signed a definitive agreement to sell its 15 percent stake in Treasure Chest Casino L.L.C., owner of the Treasure Chest Casino in Kenner, Louisiana.
Boyd is selling its interest to Treasure Chest Casino L.L.C. and its majority owner for an undisclosed sum.
The sale is subject to various governmental and regulatory approvals, and is expected to close by the end of the year.
Boyd will continue to manage Treasure Chest Casino for about one more year under a management contract that had 32 months remaining on its original term.
